description: This Java class defines the DefaultClientConfig, an immutable configuration class for client connection parameters within a messaging service. It reads configuration values from a ScopedConfig object or directly from a Config object, and exposes methods to access specific timeout and retry settings relevant for client connectivity. The class also implements equality, hash code, and string representation methods.

classes.name: DefaultClientConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of ClientConfig providing connection timeout and retry configuration parameters.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultClientConfig instance from a provided Config object, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: getConnectingMinTimeout
methods.description: Returns the minimum timeout duration for establishing a connection.

methods.name: getConnectingMaxTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout duration for establishing a connection.

methods.name: getSubscriptionManagerTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for the subscription manager.

methods.name: getConnectingMaxTries
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of connection attempts.

methods.name: getTestingTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for testing connectivity.

methods.name: getMinBackoff
methods.description: Returns the minimum backoff duration between retries.

methods.name: getMaxBackoff
methods.description: Returns the maximum backoff duration between retries.
